target.$description: Minimum pointer-target sizes. Authored as primitives so touch ergonomics are a kernel guarantee rather than a per-component literal — the 46px control height previously hardcoded in component/button.json now derives from target.min.

min.$description: Minimum interactive target — the thumb-first control height (exceeds the WCAG 2.2 AA 24px floor and the 44px platform guidance).

compact.$description: Dense affordance (icon button inside an already-large target). Only valid when the parent row itself meets target.min.

spacious.$description: Roomier target for primary actions and cognitive-accessibility mode.
